source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第三节

textbook_summary: Severe RVH may produce qR morphology in V1.
RV1 + SV5 > 1.2 mV; right-axis deviation may exceed 110 degrees.
Right precordial leads show ST depression and T-wave inversion.

authored_choices.construction: Reuses existing smooth Early/Main/Terminal basis functions. I/II targets are inverted to RA/LA/LL before projection; chest electrodes carry the Wilson reference. Q32 tables are generated offline with Fraction/ties-to-even arithmetic. These are not exact textbook case samples or actual ventricular contributions.

limitations: A qR teaching variant; Q waves are not attributed to infarction and no automatic diagnosis is made.
Fixed authored parameters, not calibrated tissue mass.
Perfusion is unchanged; Windows behavior is not yet manually verified.
